name: Galerie de Paléontologie et d'Anatomie comparée

summary.text: The Gallery of Paleontology and Comparative Anatomy is a part of the French National Museum of Natural History. It is situated in the Jardin des plantes in Paris near the Gare d'Austerlitz.
